layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive young Pachycephalosaurus with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing completely still in a balanced, low-slung bipedal posture adjacent to a stylized Late Cretaceous tree trunk. The camera frames a stable three-quarter profile from a straight eye-level view, dramatically emphasizing its massive, bulging bowling-ball skull dome and short, extra-thick bull neck to instantly signal its heavy-set, robust tank proportions. It looks forward with quiet curiosity over a soft mudstone floor under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
